name: PokeDaisy for iPhone (unofficial port)
subtitle: iPhone builds of PokeDaisy, laid out for the iPhone Duo
description: Unofficial iPhone builds of PokeDaisy from https://github.com/pgrace34/pokedaisy_ios_duo (branch ios-duo). PokeDaisy is by lidor30 (https://github.com/lidor30/pokedaisy); this port isn't the official app, so report problems with it to the fork. No games are included: play your own.

apps.name: PokeDaisy
apps.subtitle: Your Pokemon game and a live companion, side by side
apps.localizedDescription: Plays your own GBA, Game Boy and Game Boy Color games with PokeDaisy's live companion beside the game: party, bag, map, guide, Pokedex, battle info and more. Laid out for the iPhone Duo (game and companion on screen together, folded or open) and works on other iPhones. Early preview. Source and notes: https://github.com/pgrace34/pokedaisy_ios_duo/tree/ios-duo/ios
